provenanceSearch.interpretation: Directed and non-exhaustive. No exact match in reviewed results does not prove originality, authorship or universal absence of a prior source.

factualResearch.limitation: Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan funciones cívicas, alfabetización digital y makerspaces, pero no verifican cada secuencia histórica, alcance del servicio ni efecto comunitario del pasaje.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan evaluación de suelo, jardines escolares y salud del suelo urbano, pero no verifican todos los beneficios, restricciones ni relaciones causales del pasaje.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan ventajas relativas de emisiones, barreras transfronterizas y renovada autorización de coches cama, pero no verifican cada tendencia comercial, causa ni comparación del pasaje.

sourceAvailability.method: Direct HTTPS retrieval with redirect resolution, response-body SHA-256, content type and byte count.
sourceAvailability.interpretation: Availability and body identity do not establish authorship, factual verification, license, rights-holder authorization or endorsement.

studentWalkthrough.limitation: Blind content-only cognitive walkthrough; it does not test UI, accessibility, retention, bands or real students.

antiBias.optionPermutationReason: Roman numerals are stable response labels bound to heading text and cannot be shuffled independently from their text. Array order, ID-text binding, position, length, lexical overlap and per-set patterns are audited instead.

sampleAdequacy.conclusion: The sample exposes a 6/14 unique-winner lexical-overlap shortcut, an unused ii label and an 8-option extreme-cue distractor signal, but n=17 is too small to certify balanced content statistically.

applicability.evidence: Within F0.2b.5, seven learner-facing source/dependency files remain pinned and no app/component imports the audit registry. This does not certify the existing UI or repository globally.

processLimitations.firstPassTrace: The persisted hash detects ordinary mutation but is not an external append-only witness; coordinated post-hoc rewriting cannot be ruled out cryptographically.
processLimitations.directSourceReview: Direct-source review is declared by an AI reviewer and checked for exact IDs plus non-empty locators; it is not automatic proof of browsing, a human signature or factual verification.
processLimitations.provenanceSearch: Public-web search is directed and non-exhaustive; no exact match does not prove original authorship or universal absence.
